It can also cause heart block, heart failure, wheezing, low oxygen levels, drowsiness or loss of consciousness, nausea, and vomiting. Overdose is treated in an intensive care setting. Dialysis does not remove metoprolol effectively.

Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
C. 'has effectiveness condition': The subject drug is only as effective as specified in the object entity when the condition is met.
D. 'not used to treat': The subject drug is inappropriate or contraindicated for the treatment of the condition specified by the object entity.
